subject.title: Android: add adaptive app navigation sidebar

question: Should OpenClaw Android replace its current compact bottom-navigation shell with this 980 dp adaptive drawer/persistent-sidebar model for all users?
rationale: The PR is a broad user-facing navigation redesign with working proof, but CI and recordings cannot determine whether this should become the supported Android interaction model and breakpoint policy.

options.title: Sponsor the adaptive shell
options.body: Approve the drawer-plus-persistent-sidebar direction and request Android-owner review of the final interaction and breakpoint policy before merge.

options.title: Keep current navigation
options.body: Decline the global replacement and close or narrow the proposal if the existing compact navigation remains the intended Android product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the adaptive shell
recommendation.body: Approve the drawer-plus-persistent-sidebar direction and request Android-owner review of the final interaction and breakpoint policy before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is repository-level Android product direction, not an isolated implementation defect.
